Q0472

“It is the task of beauty to lead the sensuous human being…” — Friedrich Schiller (On the Aesthetic Education of Man)

Verified English quotation. Primary source: On the Aesthetic Education of Man. Theme: beauty.

Quotes / Friedrich Schiller / Q0472

English

It is the task of beauty to lead the sensuous human being to the rational human being.
Thinker Friedrich Schiller
School German Idealism
Source On the Aesthetic Education of Man
Theme Beauty
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with On the Aesthetic Education of Man, within the German Idealism tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of beauty, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Friedrich Schiller's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
